parts.label: Closed-loop ray diagram
parts.help: Explain the two rays from each visible thread point and where their images merge. Draw a labelled ray diagram and compare with the solution. This is self-review.

parts.label: Red refractive index n_R
parts.help: Read the supplied original photograph. The absolute tolerance is 0.03, matching the source's full-credit measurement range.

parts.label: Index difference n_V minus n_R
parts.help: Enter the index difference, not a percentage. Absolute tolerance 0.003 accepts both official constructions. Explain your measured width in your workings.
